name: akbun-draw
description: Image drawing skills by akbun — image-generation prompts and editable SVGs in fixed akbun styles

interface.shortDescription: Image drawing skills in fixed akbun styles
interface.longDescription: Image drawing skills that turn any subject, story, or code into image-generation prompts and Figma/Canva-editable SVGs, each in a fixed akbun illustration style — webtoons, posters, card news, hand-drawn doodle motion graphics and 2/4/6-panel doodle comics, 16:9 explainer SVGs routed through 9 design-token styles, and the akbun whale mascot spec.

Draw this script as night-gouache explainer scenes (dark painted illustrations with one glowing highlight) and export the layers for Resolve
